import json, time
import boto3
from moto import mock_aws
@mock_aws
def main():
    c = boto3.client('sqs', region_name='us-east-1')
    dlq = c.create_queue(QueueName='dlq.fifo', Attributes={'FifoQueue': 'true'})['QueueUrl']
    arn = c.get_queue_attributes(QueueUrl=dlq, AttributeNames=['QueueArn'])['Attributes']['QueueArn']
    q = c.create_queue(QueueName='q.fifo', Attributes={'FifoQueue': 'true', 'VisibilityTimeout': '1', 'RedrivePolicy': json.dumps({'deadLetterTargetArn': arn, 'maxReceiveCount': '2'})})['QueueUrl']
    c.send_message(QueueUrl=q, MessageBody='hi', MessageGroupId='g1', MessageDeduplicationId='d1')
    m1 = c.receive_message(QueueUrl=q).get('Messages', [])
    assert len(m1) == 1, 'first delivery'
    time.sleep(1.5)
    m2 = c.receive_message(QueueUrl=q).get('Messages', [])
    assert len(m2) == 1, 'timed-out message must be released from pending'
    time.sleep(1.5)
    m3 = c.receive_message(QueueUrl=q).get('Messages', [])
    assert len(m3) == 0, 'exceeded message must move to DLQ'
    d = c.receive_message(QueueUrl=dlq).get('Messages', [])
    assert len(d) == 1 and d[0]['Body'] == 'hi', 'dlq must hold the message'
    print('sqs_redrive_ok')
main()
